addressed.claim_id: Rule3: replaced numeric quantize equality check with lexical exponent check (price.as_tuple().exponent < -2) and rejection of scientific notation ("e"/"E" in string) so values like "10.000", "10.100", "0.000" are now correctly rejected.
Rule2: changed entry shape validation from subset check to exact key set check set(entry.keys())=={"date","monthly_price"} (len==2) so extra keys now raise ValueError.
Consistency: made final total.quantize explicit with ROUND_HALF_UP.
